mapper.select: /** pchSql - selectProjectExcelList - 과제별 기여율 엑셀저장 */ SELECT B.VESTICODE as "vEstiCode" /* 평가코드 */ , B.VPROJECTCODE as "vProjectCode" /* 과제코드 */ , B.VPROJECTNAME as "vProjectName" /* 과제명 */ , B.VPROJECTPM as "vProjectPm" /* 과제PM */ , ( SELECT VNAME FROM TAA2101 WHERE VEMPLNO = B.VPROJECTPM ) as "vProjectPmName" /* 과제PM명 */ , ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NCONTRIBUTION), 0) SUM FROM TCA4005 WHERE VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND VPROJECTCODE = B.VPROJECTCODE ) as "nProjectSum" /* 기여율합 */ , DECODE(B.VESTISTEP, '1', DECODE(E."vFinish", 'Y', 'PM 평가중', '연구원 입력중'), '2', DECODE(E."vConfirm", 'Y', '센터장 확인중', '연구원 확인중'), '3', '센터장 반려', '4', 'PM 최종 확인 중', '5', '최종 평가완료') as "vEstiStep" /* 진행단계 */ , E."vEmplNo" as "vEmplNo" /* 과제별 기여율 - 사번 */ , E."vName" as "vName" /* 과제별 기여율 - 성명 */ , E."vPosName" as "vPosName" /* 과제별 기여율 - 직위 */ , E."vWork" as "vWork" /* 과제별 기여율 - 업무 */ , E."vContent" as "vContent" /* 과제별 기여율 - 평가의견 */ , E."nContribution" as "nContribution" /* 과제별 기여율 - 기여율 */ , E."vFinish" as "vFinish" /* 과제별 기여율 - 완료여부 */ , E."vConfirm" as "vConfirm" /* 과제별 기여율 - 확인여부 */ FROM TCA4003 B, ( SELECT C.VESTICODE as "vEstiCode" , C.VPROJECTCODE as "vProjectCode" , C.VEMPLNO as "vEmplNo" , D.VNAME as "vName" , D.VPOSNAME as "vPosName" , C.VWORK as "vWork" , C.NCONTRIBUTION as "nContribution" , C.VCONTENT as "vContent" , C.VCONFIRM as "vConfirm" , C.VFINISH as "vFinish" FROM TCA4005 C, TCA4002 D WHERE C.VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND C.VESTICODE = D.VESTICODE AND C.VEMPLNO = D.VEMPLNO ) E WHERE B.VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND B.VPROJECTCODE = E."vProjectCode"(+) ORDER BY B.VPROJECTCODE ASC, E."nContribution" DESC

/** pchSql - selectEmplNoExcelList - 개인별 기여율 엑셀저장 */ SELECT A.VESTICODE as "vEstiCode" /* 평가코드 */ , A.VPROJECTCODE as "vProjectCode" /* 과제코드 */ , B.VPROJECTNAME as "vProjectName" /* 과제명 */ , B.VPROJECTPM as "vProjectPm" /* 과제PM */ , C.VNAME as "vProjectPmName" /* 과제PM명 */ , C.VPOSNAME as "vProjectPmPosName" /* 과제PM 직위 */ , C.VDEPTNAME as "vProjectPmDeptName" /* 과제PM 부서명 */ , C.VTEAMNAME as "vProjectPmTeamName" /* 과제PM 팀명 */ , A.VEMPLNO as "vEmplNo" /* 참여연구원 사번 */ , E.VNAME as "vName" /* 참여연구원 성명 */ , A.VWORK as "vWork" /* 업무 */ , A.NCONTRIBUTION as "nContribution" /* 기여율 */ , D."SUMCONTRIBUTION" as "nSumContribution" /* 개인 기여율합 */ , A.VCONTENT as "vContent" /* 평가의견 */ , A.VCONFIRM as "vConfirm" /* 확인여부 */ , A.VFINISH as "vFinish" /* 완료여부 */ FROM TCA4005 A, TCA4003 B, TCA4002 C, ( SELECT AA.VEMPLNO as "VEMPLNO" , NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(BB.NCONTRIBUTION, 0)) FROM TCA4005 BB WHERE AA.VESTICODE = BB.VESTICODE AND AA.VEMPLNO = BB.VEMPLNO GROUP BY BB.VESTICODE, BB.VEMPLNO ), 0) as "SUMCONTRIBUTION" FROM TCA4002 AA WHERE AA.VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND AA.VESTIYN = 'Y' ) D, TAA2101 E WHERE A.VESTICODE = B.VESTICODE AND A.VPROJECTCODE = B.VPROJECTCODE AND B.VPROJECTPM = C.VEMPLNO AND A.VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND C.VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND A.VEMPLNO = D."VEMPLNO"(+) AND A.VEMPLNO = E.VEMPLNO(+) ORDER BY E.VNAME ASC
